Name: StarShade
Author: 8BitBunnie
Description:
(Install instructions)

1. Download and Install ReShade (https://reshade.me/)

2. Launch ReShade and browse to wherever your Stardew Valley exe is installed
(Likely C:\Program Files(x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley)

3. select "OpenGL" and click "Uncheck All" then "Check All"

4. Wait for Reshade to install then download the file included

5. Then place the file into C:\Program Files(x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley

6. Launch Stardew Valley then wait for ReShade to start, and press the "Home"
button and skip the tutorial (or read it if you need to)

7. Press the button on the top of the ReShade menu where it says "ReShadePreset" and set it to "StarShade" (Set it to "WinterStarShade" When the season is winter)
